PRIORITY GUIDELINES
===================

High Priority (Create First):
- Before/after comparisons showing your impact
- User interfaces demonstrating design quality
- Process documentation (journey maps, research)
- Quantitative results (dashboards, metrics)

Medium Priority:
- Behind-the-scenes photos (workshops, testing)
- Technical diagrams (architecture, flows)

Visual Style Guidelines:
- Clean, minimal aesthetic matching your retro-OS theme
- Consistent visual treatment within each project
- Focus on clarity and readability
- Ensure screenshots show your design work prominently

IMPACT FOR AGENCIES
===================
This streamlined set demonstrates:
✅ Strategic thinking (journey maps, research)
✅ Design execution (interfaces, before/after)
✅ Quantitative impact (metrics, A/B testing)
✅ Process transparency (collaboration, iteration)
✅ Technical depth (systems, architecture)
✅ Real-world application (hospital photos, user testing)

Perfect balance of showing your complete design process without overwhelming the viewer.
